verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an API-key-authenticated REST API (Bearer token, keys generated in the platform dashboard to manage projects). Its built-in MCP server is claimed to let AI clients build flows, manage tables, test automations and "drive the whole platform." However, nothing explicitly states REST API parity with the UI, the endpoint coverage is not described, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented endpoint coverage for all UI features (flows, publishing approvals, agents, governance), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
